_how_to_edit: The story page reads this file on every load. See outages/UPDATE.md. Times are hours on an Eastern clock counted from midnight starting Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026 (35.5 = 11:30 a.m. Friday, Nov. 13; 131 = 11 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 17).
headline_status: NSA Net was still down Thursday evening, with NSA headquarters closed to most staff until further notice, CNN sources said
nsa_start_label: first reported by about 11 a.m. Eastern Tuesday

outages.name: Microsoft 365
outages.label: About 24 hours
outages.note: Exchange Online failed at about 11:17 a.m. Eastern on Thursday, Nov. 12. Microsoft's preliminary report puts the outage at nearly 24 hours, and it said the last affected customers were restored early Saturday. It blamed a software defect exposed by network work, not an attack.

outages.name: FAA ground stop
outages.label: 4 hr 21 min
outages.note: The FAA halted every departure at 3:54 p.m. Eastern on Friday, Nov. 13, and lifted the stop at 8:05 p.m. FlightAware counted about 9,200 cancellations. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said a router overloaded while contractor L3Harris moved FAA lines from copper to fiber, but said the fault was not yet determined. The FBI is giving technical support to the review.

outages.name: Workday
outages.label: Back by Saturday
outages.note: Outage reports jumped just after 5 p.m. Eastern on Friday, Nov. 13. Workday said service was restored by Saturday but has not given an end time, so the bar fades out.

outages.name: Chase
outages.label: Morning to 6:30 p.m.
outages.note: Complaints began climbing Monday morning, Nov. 16, and passed 4,700 on Downdetector by about 1 p.m. Chase blamed a software bug in an on-premises hardware system, not an attack, and said transactions were posting normally by about 6:30 p.m. Eastern.

outages.name: United Airlines
outages.label: About 1 hr 40 min
outages.note: United delayed departures from just before 5 p.m. Eastern on Monday, Nov. 16, after a failure in the system pilots use to get aircraft weights. The airline resolved it about an hour and 40 minutes after pilots first reported problems.

outages.name: Apple
outages.label: About 2¾ hours
outages.note: Apple's services began failing at about 11:45 a.m. Eastern on Tuesday, Nov. 17. Users were signed out of iCloud and could not reach the App Store, Apple Pay or Apple Music, and Apple stores could not complete sales. Apple blamed an internal update, said it was not a cyberattack and said by about 2:30 p.m. that the problem was largely resolved.

outages.name: NSA Net
outages.label: Still down Thu. night
outages.note: CNN reported Tuesday, Nov. 17, that NSA Net was down, with no evidence of a cyberattack. The NSA blamed “temporary degradation during scheduled routine maintenance,” and DNI Jay Clayton blamed patching. CBS sources said Wednesday evening it was back up, but CNN and NBC News sources said Thursday it was still down, and a senior official told CNN restoration was slower than expected.

status_html: NSA Net remained down Thursday evening, its third day, according to CNN and NBC News, both citing unnamed sources. CNN reported that the Fort Meade campus was closed to most staff until further notice, that a senior administration official called restoration “slower than expected,” and CNN correspondent Natasha Bertrand said full operation could stretch into Friday. CBS sources had said Wednesday evening the network was back up. Officials told CNN the outage appears tied to patches for PHP software vulnerabilities, and DNI Jay Clayton told a House hearing Wednesday that the outages were not a coordinated attack.
notknown_html:
When NSA Net will be fully restored, and how many employees and sites were affected; CNN and NBC sources said the NSA’s Georgia center for Middle East intelligence had to use workarounds. The NSA has not made a public statement since Tuesday, when it said mission-critical capabilities remained fully operational. Sen. Chuck Schumer has asked for a review, saying the timing is “too coincidental.” Not counted here: a separate cyberattack through the website tool Optimizely that reached sites of 178 organizations, which no one has tied to these outages.

This story reflects reporting through 8:05 p.m. Eastern on Nov. 19. The chart’s NSA bar runs to the present and will end when the NSA or a major outlet reports the network restored.
